title: Capstone: Autonomous Research Agent
description: Ship a production-style autonomous research agent: planning → tools → memory → resumability → approval gates → tracing. The agent researches a topic across multiple sources, cites everything, respects budgets, pauses for approval on risky actions, and produces an auditable report.
learningObjectives: Combine planning, tool use, and durable memory in one system
Enforce budgets and approval gates on a long-running loop
Trace every step for post-hoc audit
Evaluate research quality with citation-grounded scoring, not vibes

milestones.title: Planning + tool core
milestones.objective: Implement plan-execute loop with ≥4 tools (search, fetch, note, cite) and typed tool results.
milestones.expectedOutput: A research task completes with structured notes and citations.

milestones.title: Memory + resumability
milestones.objective: Persist working memory; mid-run kill resumes without losing progress or duplicating work.

milestones.title: Approval gates + budgets
milestones.objective: Gate risky actions (external posts, large fetches) behind approval; enforce time/cost budgets.

milestones.title: Research-quality evaluation
milestones.objective: Define citation-grounded scoring (every claim must trace to a source); run ≥3 research tasks and grade.
milestones.expectedOutput: Graded research reports with claim coverage stats.

categories.minimumExpectation: Research tasks complete with resumable state

architecture: planner → executor loop → durable memory → tools → citation ledger → report
constraints: All fetched content cached with provenance
hints: Claim-coverage scoring ('what fraction of statements have live citations') is the honest quality metric here

requiredEvidence.description: Run report with budget + audit trail.
